PLpgSQL_expr.query:
SELECT 1
      FROM integration_organization
     WHERE organization_id=org
       AND status='ACTIVE'
     FOR SHARE

SELECT 1
      FROM command_principal
     WHERE organization_id=org
       AND principal_id=actor
     FOR UPDATE

SELECT unnest(
            ARRAY[
                'transaction-identity/subject/1:' ||
                    org || ':' || conn || ':' ||
                    octet_length(ref) || ':' || ref,

                'transaction-identity/target/1:' ||
                    org || ':' || target
            ]
        )
        ORDER BY 1
